thread:
marta: Heads up — onboarding sample app in EU is creating duplicate side-effects after a token rotate during a retry burst. Noticed a few 429+auth-refresh combos. Anyone else?

leo: Yep saw something similar last week in staging. Symptoms: client retries after 429, token refresh occurs mid-retry, and the retried request doesn't carry the idempotency header.

sara: Can you paste the SDK config and a small log snippet?

marta: Log excerpt: `POST /charge 429` then `auth: refresh started`, then `POST /charge 200` twice. Config (node sample):
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  retries: 4,
  backoff: 'exponential',
  jitter: 0, // left as 0 in our sample app
  safeReplayWindowMs: 60000, // 60s
  attachIdempotencyToken: false // sample app default atm
});
```

james: That combination explains it. Our Go SDK switched to "full jitter" earlier this quarter; Node sample app had no jitter and disabled idempotency tokens in the quickstart. If refresh replaces credentials between attempts and the retry logic doesn't reattach the idempotency header, you can get a replayed side-effect.

devex-bot: Reminder: PR templates now include "repro steps" + "env vars to toggle".

sara: Short-term mitigation: bump sample app to `safeReplayWindowMs: 120000`, enable `attachIdempotencyToken: true`, and add jitter > 0. Medium-term: align SDK defaults and add docs callout about token-rotate race.

leo: Proposed minimal change for the sample app (Go snippet):
```go
mu.Lock() // ensure single refresh in-flight per client
if expired() { refreshToken() }
// send request with idempotency header
mu.Unlock()
```
This prevents double-refresh races in local samples.

james: Can someone open a tiny bug with repro steps + links to logs so I can pick it up? I'll do a cross-SDK spec for default retry/jitter/idempotency.

marta: Done: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/5432 — includes minimal repro, logs, and sample app config. Repro triggers with: rapid 429s + immediate token rotate (simulate by toggling env var in sample).

sara: Nice. I'll update the quickstart to enable idempotency tokens and add a short note in the SDK parity doc about token-rotate behavior. :thumbsup:

leo: If we standardize on "exponential + full jitter" + attach-idempotency-by-default we should avoid most of these dupes.

marta: Agree. Thanks all — will watch the PR. :eyes:
